verdict.rationale: Fastmail's API is JMAP, an open standard. Fetching `/.well-known/jmap` returns a machine-readable session object listing capabilities, accounts and API URLs, which is runtime discovery rather than a downloadable schema. A Fastmail API documentation page exists, but no OpenAPI or equivalent spec file is evidenced, and probes of the usual OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 (though only on the help domain). Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/JSON-schema-style spec, evidence of machine-readable method and type definitions, and independent confirmation that agents can consume such a spec.
